segments.text: Today we are going to build a small wooden bookshelf from scratch.
first you need to measure the wall where it will stand.
I like to use a long tape measure and a pencil.
Next, cut the side panels to the same height.
sand every edge until it feels smooth to the touch.
Then glue the shelves into place and clamp them overnight.
The next morning, remove the clamps carefully.
Apply a thin coat of oil to protect the wood.
Let it dry for a full day before loading any books.
And that is really all there is to it.
Thanks for watching, and I will see you next time.
